name: AP62300
description: Low-cost 18 V, 3 A synchronous COT buck in TSOT-23-6 or SOT-563 for 3.3 V/5 V rails from 5 V or 12 V inputs.
notes: 18 V max: fine for 12 V and 3S LiPo, marginal for 4S (16.8 V full).
The SOT-563 and TSOT-23-6 versions have different pinouts.

en.note: Internal 1.5 µA pull-up from VCC: leave floating for automatic start-up. Do NOT tie to VIN (EN abs max 8 V, VIN up to 18 V). Threshold 1.20 V rising (1.25 max) / 1.10 V falling; 5.5 µA hysteresis current above threshold. Optional UVLO divider R3 (VIN-EN) / R4 (EN-GND): R3 = (0.917*VON - VOFF)/5.625 µA, R4 = 1.1*R3/(VOFF - 1.1 V + 7 µA*R3), VON > 4.15 V, VOFF > 3.85 V. Optional EN-GND delay cap Cd[nF] ~ 0.278*td[ms].

notes: Constant-on-time (COT) control, internally compensated; tON = VOUT/(VIN*fSW); 750 kHz is the pseudo-fixed frequency at VIN 12 V, VOUT 5 V, CCM. AP62300 enters PFM at light load (AP62301 is the forced-PWM twin).

No peak/high-side current limit is specified: only a low-side VALLEY limit of 3.7 A typ (3.2 min / 4.2 max). Hiccup after 2.5 ms at the valley limit or FB < 495 mV; 20 ms off. ilimA left null for that reason.
Inductor: L = VOUT*(VIN-VOUT)/(VIN*dIL*fSW) with dIL = 30-50 % of the 3 A MAXIMUM load current; 1.2-4.7 µH for most applications; DC rating >= 35 % above max load; DCR < 30 mOhm.

Table 1 feed-forward cap C5 across R1 is optional: Open for 1.2/1.5 V, 10-100 pF for 1.8-5 V. Boot cap C6: 100 nF (<= 1.8 V), 100-220 nF (2.5 V), 100-330 nF (3.3/5 V); text: higher boot capacitance recommended when VOUT > 2.5 V.

Output cap: 22-68 µF ceramic sufficient for most applications (Table 1 µses 2x22 µF). Ripple dV = dIL*(ESR + 1/(8*fSW*COUT)); transient COUT > max(L*Itrans^2/(dVover*VOUT), L*Itrans^2/(dVunder*(VIN-VOUT))).
Input cap: ceramic >= 10 µF sufficient; RMS rating > half the max load current.
VOUT range 0.8-7 V (recommended operating). VIN 4.2-18 V, abs max 20 V DC / 22 V 400 ms; POR 3.9 V rising, UVLO 3.6 V falling.
Two packages with DIFFERENT pinouts: TSOT26 (AP62300WU-7) 1 GND, 2 SW, 3 VIN, 4 FB, 5 EN, 6 BST; SOT563 (AP62300Z6-7) 1 VIN, 2 SW, 3 GND, 4 BST, 5 EN, 6 FB. Same external circuit.
AP62300T (not this part) µses a 0.763 V reference with its own R1 column.
Layout: CIN tight across VIN/GND, inductor close to SW, feedback parts close to FB; many vias at GND and VIN pins; 2 oz copper recommended.
